statement: The minimum real solution count is 0.
scope: Smooth real conics; 2 general points and 3 general lines.
notes:
Example 7.1 constructs a generic configuration with no real solutions. Real projective duality exchanges 3 points/2 lines with 2 points/3 lines.

This is an elementary real-configuration or conjugation/duality deduction, with Bashelor–Ksir–Traves retained as an expository verification source. Their paper explicitly disclaims novelty; no original discovery is attributed to them here.

The following bibliography supplies historical attribution or supporting background for the result. Andrew Bashelor, Amy Ksir, Will Traves, Enumerative Algebraic Geometry of Conics (2008, bashelor_ksir_traves_2008_conics).
